name: macro_record
description: Controls Hybrid Semantic Macro recording. Captures user/agent interactions, attaches 5-Tier Semantic Anchors (UIA, WinRT OCR token, 32x32 pHash, DPI-normalized client ratio), and applies RDP polyline compression to trajectories.

action.description: Recorder action: start, stop, status, or cancel.

name.description: Unique identifier / filename for the macro (required for start).

target.description: Optional window title substring to scope recording strictly to that application window.

capture_trajectories.description: Whether to record continuous mouse trajectory paths with RDP compression.
